content: Bemotrizinol, also known by its USAN name and marketed under the trade name Tinosorb® S, is a chemical compound with the INCI designation Bis-Ethylhexyloxyphenol Methoxyphenyl Triazine. It is an oil-soluble ingredient that is incorporated into sunscreen formulations to effectively absorb ultraviolet (UV) radiation. This compound is produced and marketed by Ciba Specialty Chemicals. Bemotrizinol functions as a broad-spectrum UV absorber, meaning it is capable of absorbing both UVB and UVA rays. One of its notable properties is its high photostability, with only 4% degradation under prolonged UV exposure. This stability not only ensures its own efficacy but also helps to prevent the photodegradation of other active ingredients in sunscreen formulations, thereby enhancing the overall performance of the product. Despite its efficacy, Bemotrizinol has not been approved by the United States Food and Drug Administration (FDA). However, it has been approved for use in the European Union since the year 2000 and is also authorized in other regions, including Australia. Importantly, unlike some other organic sunscreen agents, Bemotrizinol does not exhibit estrogenic effects in in vitro studies, making it a safer option in terms of hormonal activity.
